records.title: MK-Curve QR / Python port
records.method: Reuse protocol/design checks and LAPACK workspace sizes while keeping the same pivoted QR and full b0 grid.

records.title: MK-Curve signal reuse
records.method: Within each chunk, reuse non-b0 signals and their logarithms across the full synthetic-b0 scan; update only the candidate b0 column.
records.baseline: The preceding qualified-QR Python implementation versus added signal reuse; solver, grid, correction rules and one numerical thread stay fixed.
records.unchanged: Original/corrected coefficients, complete curves, parameter maps, residuals and validity masks match exactly in all three acquisitions and both solvers.
records.limitation: Displayed medians use acquisition 1, selected consistently with the earlier QR record. Three alternating repeats after one warmup. Batched-path changes range from -1.50% to +3.07%, so signal reuse remains enabled only for the reference solver. These incremental timings overlap the earlier QR implementation and are not additive.
records.sample: Three acquisitions, 64 voxels each, 181 measurements and 200-201 synthetic-b0 samples. Reference-QR time falls 10.24-11.26%. Numeric computation only; input preparation and file export excluded.
records.upstream_reference: Recorded 29 October with SciPy 1.18.1; source/input checksums and one-thread settings are preserved. This is an incremental comparison within the Python port, following the qualified QR change.

records.title: CSD/ACT post-tracking SIFT2 & VTK/TRK export
records.method: Execute independent consumers of the finished 1M-streamline .tck file (tcksift2, multi-threaded tckconvert to VTK and streaming TCK-to-TRK conversion) concurrently in a bounded thread pool.
records.baseline: Sequential execution of tcksift2 followed by tckconvert (.vtk) followed by Python TCK-to-TRK export on the same 1,000,000-streamline tractogram.
records.unchanged: All three outputs (SIFT2 weights/mu, 3.44 GB VTK polydata and 1.21 GB TRK tractogram) pass full 1,000,000-streamline integrity validation.
records.limitation: Measured phase wall time from tckgen completion to completion of SIFT2, VTK and TRK exports on HCP 100408 (8-thread budget).
records.sample: 1,000,000 whole-brain ACT streamlines + MSMT-CSD wmfod.mif on HCP 100408.
records.upstream_reference: Concurrent execution of unmodified MRtrix3 tcksift2, tckconvert and streaming TRK export after tckgen completes.

records.title: WMQL 48-bundle rule-based queries (CPU)
records.method: Load VTK/TRK streamlines into flat CSR arrays, compute voxel-label crossings via multi-threaded vectorized bincount histograms with lazy CSR sets and export binary VTK bundles concurrently.
records.baseline: Upstream tract_querier per-streamline Python point loops, dense dict/set construction and sequential VTK bundle writing.
records.unchanged: All 48 official queries and 41 non-empty white-matter bundles match upstream tract_querier streamline counts identically (0 mismatches).
records.limitation: Subject 100307 complete WMQL stage on 8 CPU threads including VTK load, 48 query evaluations, 41 bundle exports and QC.
records.sample: Full HCP 100307 UKF tractogram + DDParcel wmparc atlas; 48 official WMQL queries; CPU execution.
records.upstream_reference: Custom CSR spatial indexing and parallel binary VTK export feeding upstream tract_querier query evaluation; 48 official queries unchanged.

records.title: WMQL 48-bundle rule-based queries (CUDA)
records.method: Evaluate RAS-to-IJK voxel label lookup, endpoint indexing and per-tract crossing histograms on CUDA tensors in VRAM-bounded chunks alongside lazy CSR query evaluation and parallel binary VTK export.
records.baseline: Upstream tract_querier CPU per-streamline Python spatial indexing and sequential bundle export (tract_querier has no GPU backend).
records.unchanged: All 48 queries and 41 non-empty bundles match both upstream baseline and optimized CPU streamline counts identically (0 mismatches).
records.limitation: Subject 100307 median of three complete WMQL runs on NVIDIA H100; at ~280k tracks VTK disk I/O (~5 s) exceeds GPU kernel time, whereas GPU scales to multi-million-track tractograms.
records.sample: Full HCP 100307 UKF tractogram + DDParcel wmparc atlas; 48 official WMQL queries; CUDA execution.
records.upstream_reference: Custom CUDA crossing-histogram spatial indexing and parallel binary VTK export feeding upstream tract_querier query evaluation.

records.title: TractCloud point-cloud parcellation (CPU)
records.method: Vectorize CSR polyline arc-length resampling for 15-point local + 20-neighbor global features, pre-stage contiguous batches and write compressed .vtp bundles concurrently from cached CSR coordinates.
records.baseline: Per-streamline DIPY set_number_of_points loops, per-batch NumPy/tensor re-packing, duplicate whole-brain tractogram reload and serial level-9 VTP compression.
records.unchanged: All 39/39 non-empty anatomical bundles match baseline per-bundle streamline counts identically (exact_bundle_count = 39/39).
records.limitation: Subject 100307 complete TractCloud stage on 4 CPU threads with fixed random_seed=0.
records.sample: HCP 100307 CSD/ACT tractogram + TractCloud 800-cluster atlas; 42 target tracts; CPU execution.
records.upstream_reference: Vectorized CSR streamline resampling and parallel fast-zlib VTP export around official TractCloud DGCNN+PointNet weights.

records.title: TractCloud point-cloud parcellation (CUDA)
records.method: Combine vectorized CSR feature resampling with GPU-resident dataset slicing (preserving exact torch.Generator batch order), IEEE FP32 cuDNN DGCNN+PointNet forward passes and parallel fast-zlib .vtp export.
records.baseline: Unoptimized TractCloud pipeline with Python per-streamline resampling, per-batch host-to-GPU DataLoader collation, disabled cuDNN and serial VTP export.
records.unchanged: All 39/39 non-empty anatomical bundles match baseline CUDA streamline counts identically (exact_bundle_count = 39/39).
records.limitation: Subject 100307 median of three complete TractCloud runs on NVIDIA H100 + 4 CPU threads (random_seed=0).
records.sample: HCP 100307 CSD/ACT tractogram + TractCloud 800-cluster atlas; 42 target tracts; CUDA execution.
records.upstream_reference: Vectorized CSR resampling, GPU-resident batching and IEEE FP32 cuDNN execution on official TractCloud weights.

upstream_review.policy: Latest release and default-branch source identity are checked separately; source review is not a development-branch benchmark.

policy: Output equivalence is not anatomical or clinical validation. No whole-workflow speedup has been established.
